# Delray Commercial

> Direct-to-seller commercial real estate brokerage in Delray Beach, Florida, operating through Mangrove Realty, Inc. Broker-owner Damara Cohn has 25+ years of experience. Covers multifamily, retail, industrial, land and NNN properties from Lighthouse Point to West Palm Beach. No committees, no institutional layers: a direct conversation with the broker.

Phone: (561) 637-4559
Website: https://delraycommercial.com/

## Main pages
- [Sell Your Commercial Real Estate](https://delraycommercial.com/): Direct-to-seller brokerage for commercial property owners.
- [Buyers](https://delraycommercial.com/buyers.html): Commercial real estate for sale, plus off-market multifamily, retail, industrial and land opportunities.
- [FAQ](https://delraycommercial.com/faq.html): Answers on off-market deals, cap rates, 1031 exchanges and timelines.
- [Referral Partners](https://delraycommercial.com/referral-partners.html): Reciprocal referral relationship for commercial lenders, 1031 exchange facilitators and estate attorneys.
- [Financing](https://delraycommercial.com/financing.html): Connections to commercial lenders for acquisition and refinancing.
